title: What is this blog?
text:
(photo on the left is from Steven Creek Reservoir in USA)  Welcome! I will be using this site to mostly write about topics of interest including research/data science; some of my other passions like art and travelling outdoors; and some culture stuff (which includes TV/anime, books, and more). I might also include some code demonstrations.
Happy exploring! :-)
If you need to go back to my main website, you can always click “Homepage” on the navigation menu.
